#!/usr/bin/env bash
# CHANGELOG size guard (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
# CHANGELOG.md exceeds its hard content cap (262144 bytes) — v1.0.538 died at
# `dart publish` AFTER the tag + GitHub release existed, so the version
# never reached pub.dev. The changelog is append-only by convention and the
# auto-release grows it near-daily; nothing bounded it before this guard.
#
# Callers (keep both wired — test/changelog_cap_guard_test.dart asserts them):
#   - scripts/auto_release.sh     — BEFORE the bump commit/tag (pre-tag fast-fail)
#   - ci.yml `publish` job gate   — BEFORE staging/upload (pre-upload fast-fail)
#
# Usage: check_changelog_size.sh [file] [cap_bytes]
#   file  defaults to CHANGELOG.md (the file pub packs)
#   cap   defaults to 262144 (the pub.dev cap); an override exists for tests
#
# Exit 0 = under the cap. Exit 1 = missing file or size >= cap, with a
# ::error:: annotation naming the fix (archive older entries).
set -euo pipefail

file="${1:-CHANGELOG.md}"
cap="${2:-262144}"

if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
  echo "::error::check_changelog_size.sh: $file does not exist — a release without a changelog is a broken release (gh-1452)."
  exit 1
fi

size=$(wc -c < "$file")

  exit 1
fi
echo "$file: $size bytes < $cap cap — ok"
```

# (the PR stopgap from 2026-09-29 is retired: it burned a full CI queue
    # cycle + machine review round on every chore bump). The App token is
    # minted job-locally; nothing else in the repo can read RELEASE_APP_*.
    # release-tag below cuts the tag from the pushed commit. Scheduled runs
    # catch up commits that outpaced the coalesce window.
    # !cancelled() + explicit gate check: GitHub propagates "skipped"
    # TRANSITIVELY through an always()-job's needs graph. quality-gate uses
    # if: always() and its needs include path-gated legs (perf-gate etc.)
    # that skip on ordinary pushes — without !cancelled() this job was
    # force-skipped on EVERY run since the perf gate landed (fa#456),
    # silently killing auto-release for a week. The explicit result check
    # keeps the gate red-line: no release on a failed quality gate.
    # workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the bypass App's push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-

    # App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs write —

      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # bypass credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (push, schedule, releaseDispatch) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0

          # bypass actor, so scope the token to what the push needs instead
          # of every permission the installation carries.
          permissions: contents:write

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# CHANGELOG size guard (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
# CHANGELOG.md exceeds its hard content cap — `Message from server:
# CHANGELOG.md exceeds the maximum content length (262144 bytes)`. v1.0.538
# died at `dart pub publish` AFTER the tag + GitHub release existed, so the
# version never reached pub.dev. The changelog is append-only by convention
# and the auto-release grows it near-daily; nothing bounded it before this
# guard.
#
# Callers (keep both wired — test/changelog_cap_guard_test.dart asserts the
# wiring):
#   - scripts/auto_release.sh   — BEFORE the bump commit/tag (pre-tag
#     fast-fail: the push is what fires tag_release + the publish job);
#   - .github/workflows/ci.yml `publish` job gate — BEFORE staging/upload
#     (the server reject is the worst possible discovery point).
#
# Usage: check_changelog_size.sh [file] [cap_bytes]
#   file  defaults to CHANGELOG.md (the file pub packs);
#   cap   defaults to 262144 (the pub.dev cap) — strict less-than; the
#         override exists for tests.
#
# Exit 0 = under the cap. Exit 1 = missing file or size >= cap, with a
# ::error:: annotation naming the fix (archive the tail).
set -euo pipefail

file="${1:-CHANGELOG.md}"
cap="${2:-262144}"

if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
  echo "::error::check_changelog_size.sh: $file does not exist — a release without a changelog is a broken release (gh-1452)."
  exit 1
fi

size=$(wc -c < "$file")
if [ "$size" -ge "$cap" ]; then
  echo "::error::$file is $size bytes — pub.dev rejects uploads at/over the ${cap}-byte content cap (gh-1452: v1.0.538 died mid-upload). Archive older entries to CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (keep ~30 recent versions inline) and re-run the release."
  exit 1
fi
echo "$file: $size bytes < $cap-byte cap — ok"
","path":"scripts/check_changelog_size.sh"}

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open

# version never reached pub.dev. The changelog is append-only by convention

# guard.
#
# Callers (keep both wired — test/changelog_cap_guard_test.dart asserts the
# wiring):
#   - scripts/auto_release.sh   — BEFORE the bump commit/tag (pre-tag
#     fast-fail: the push is what fires tag_release + the publish job);
#   - .github/workflows/ci.yml `publish` job gate — BEFORE staging/upload
#     (the server reject is the worst possible discovery point).
#
# Usage: check_changelog_size.sh [file] [cap_bytes]
#   file  defaults to CHANGELOG.md (the file pub packs);
#   cap   defaults to 262144 (the pub.dev cap) — strict less-than; the
#         override exists for tests.
#
# Exit 0 = under the cap. Exit 1 = missing file or size >= cap, with a
# ::error:: annotation naming the fix (archive the tail).
set -euo pipefail

file="${1:-CHANGELOG.md}"
cap="${2:-262144}"

if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
  echo "::error::check_changelog_size.sh: $file does not exist — a release without a changelog is a broken release (gh-1452)."
  exit 1
fi

size=$(wc -c < "$file")
if [ "$size" -ge "$cap" ]; then
  echo "::error::$file is $size bytes — pub.dev rejects uploads at/over the ${cap}-byte content cap (gh-1452: v1.0.538 died mid-upload). Archive older entries to CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (keep ~30 recent versions inline) and re-run the release."
  exit 1
fi
echo "$file: $size bytes < $cap-byte cap — ok"

    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run

    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.

    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# CHANGELOG size guard (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
# CHANGELOG.md exceeds its hard content cap — `Message from server:
# CHANGELOG.md exceeds the maximum content length (262144 bytes)`. v1.0.538
# died at `dart pub publish` AFTER the tag + GitHub release existed, so the
# version never reached pub.dev. The changelog is append-only by convention
# and the auto-release grows it near-daily; nothing bounded it before this
# guard.
#
# Callers (keep both wired — test/changelog_cap_guard_test.dart asserts the
# wiring):
#   - scripts/auto_release.sh   — BEFORE the bump commit/tag (pre-tag
#     fast-fail: the push is what fires tag_release + the publish job);
#   - .github/workflows/ci.yml `publish` job gate — BEFORE staging/upload
#     (the server reject is the worst possible discovery point).
#
# Usage: check_changelog_size.sh [file] [cap_bytes]
#   file  defaults to CHANGELOG.md (the file pub packs);
#   cap   defaults to 262144 (the pub.dev cap) — strict less-than; the
#         override exists for tests.
#
# Exit 0 = under the cap. Exit 1 = missing file or size >= cap, with a
# ::error:: annotation naming the fix (archive the tail).
set -euo pipefail

file="${1:-CHANGELOG.md}"
cap="${2:-262144}"

if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
  echo "::error::check_changelog_size.sh: $file does not exist — a release without a changelog is a broken release (gh-1452)."
  exit 1
fi

size=$(wc -c < "$file")
if [ "$size" -ge "$cap" ]; then
  echo "::error::$file is $size bytes — pub.dev rejects uploads at/over the ${cap}-byte content cap (gh-1452: v1.0.538 died mid-upload). Archive older entries to CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (keep ~30 recent versions inline) and re-run the release."
  exit 1
fi
echo "$file: $size bytes < $cap-byte cap — ok"

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic

    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# CHANGELOG size guard (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
# CHANGELOG.md exceeds its hard content cap — `Message from server:
# CHANGELOG.md exceeds the maximum content length (262144 bytes)`. v1.0.538
# died at `dart pub publish` AFTER the tag + GitHub release existed, so the
# version never reached pub.dev. The changelog is append-only by convention
# and the auto-release grows it near-daily; nothing bounded it before this
# guard.
#
# Callers (keep both wired — test/changelog_cap_guard_test.dart asserts the
# wiring):
#   - scripts/auto_release.sh   — BEFORE the bump commit/tag (pre-tag
#     fast-fail: the push is what fires tag_release + the publish job);
#   - .github/workflows/ci.yml `publish` job gate — BEFORE staging/upload
#     (the server reject is the worst possible discovery point).
#
# Usage: check_changelog_size.sh [file] [cap_bytes]
#   file  defaults to CHANGELOG.md (the file pub packs);
#   cap   defaults to 262144 (the pub.dev cap) — strict less-than; the
#         override exists for tests.
#
# Exit 0 = under the cap. Exit 1 = missing file or size >= cap, with a
# ::error:: annotation naming the fix (archive the tail).
set -euo pipefail

file="${1:-CHANGELOG.md}"
cap="${2:-262144}"

if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
  echo "::error::check_changelog_size.sh: $file does not exist — a release without a changelog is a broken release (gh-1452)."
  exit 1
fi

size=$(wc -c < "$file")
if [ "$size" -ge "$cap" ]; then
  echo "::error::$file is $size bytes — pub.dev rejects uploads at/over the ${cap}-byte content cap (gh-1452: v1.0.538 died mid-upload). Archive older entries to CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (keep ~30 recent versions inline) and re-run the release."
  exit 1
fi
echo "$file: $size bytes < $cap-byte cap — ok"
","path":"scripts/check_changelog_size.sh"}

KEEP = 30

archive_body = orig_body[:cut].rstrip('\n')

kept = header + (

) + window_body
archive = (

) + archive_body + '\n'

# Lossless content: archive tail + window == the original body exactly.
assert archive_body + '\n\n' + window_body == orig_body, 'reassembly mismatch'
open('CHANGELOG.md', 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(kept)
open('CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md', 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(archive)

    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes

tags:
  integration:

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf

    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed

import re

    'on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose\n'

tags:

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf

    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed

    'on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose\n'

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate
        name: Publish gate
        run: |
          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then
            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."
            exit 1
          fi
          # gh-1452: pub.dev server-rejects the upload when CHANGELOG.md is
          # at/over its 262144-byte content cap (v1.0.538 died mid-upload,
          # after the tag + GitHub release). Fast-fail HERE, before staging
          # and publish, not at the server.
          bash scripts/check_changelog_size.sh CHANGELOG.md
          echo "publishable=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: steps.gate.outputs.publishable == 'true'
        with:

    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate
        name: Publish gate
        run: |
          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then
            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."
            exit 1
          fi
          # gh-1452: pub.dev server-rejects the upload when CHANGELOG.md is
          # at/over its 262144-byte content cap (v1.0.538 died mid-upload,
          # after the tag + GitHub release). Fast-fail HERE, before staging
          # and publish, not at the server.
          bash scripts/check_changelog_size.sh CHANGELOG.md
          echo "publishable=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: steps.gate.outputs.publishable == 'true'
        with:

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate
        name: Publish gate
        run: |
          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then
            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."

    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm

    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open

      - id: gate

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate
        name: Publish gate
        run: |
          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then
            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate
        name: Publish gate
        run: |
          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then
            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."

          # gh-1452: pub.dev server-rejects the upload when CHANGELOG.md is

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate
        name: Publish gate
        run: |
          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then
            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate
        name: Publish gate
        run: |
          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then
            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."
            exit 1

          # gh-1452: pub.dev server-rejects the upload when CHANGELOG.md is

          bash scripts/check_changelog_size.sh CHANGELOG.md

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf

    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate
        name: Publish gate
        run: |
          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then
            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."
            exit 1
          fi
          # gh-1452: pub.dev server-rejects the upload when CHANGELOG.md is
          # at/over its 262144-byte content cap (v1.0.538 died mid-upload,
          # after the tag + GitHub release). Fast-fail HERE, before staging
          # and publish, not at the server.
          bash scripts/check_changelog_size.sh CHANGELOG.md
          echo "publishable=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: steps.gate.outputs.publishable == 'true'
        with:

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf

    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate

        run: |

            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.

    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate
        name: Publish gate
        run: |
          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then
            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."
            exit 1
          fi
          # gh-1452: pub.dev server-rejects the upload when CHANGELOG.md is

          # after the tag + GitHub release). Fast-fail HERE, before staging
          # and publish, not at the server.
          bash scripts/check_changelog_size.sh CHANGELOG.md
          echo "publishable=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate
        name: Publish gate
        run: |
          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then
            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."
            exit 1
          fi
          # gh-1452: pub.dev server-rejects the upload when CHANGELOG.md is

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.

    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes

    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),

    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.

    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.

      - id: gate

  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open

      - id: gate

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate
        name: Publish gate
        run: |
          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then
            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."
            exit 1
          fi
          # gh-1452: pub.dev server-rejects the upload when CHANGELOG.md is
          # at/over its 262144-byte content cap (v1.0.538 died mid-upload,

      - id: gate

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,

      - id: gate

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate

          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate
        name: Publish gate
        run: |
          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then
            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."

      - id: gate

# A tag is a release announcement: if pubspec says publish_to: none,
      # failing LOUDLY is correct (#554) — a green skip is how pub.dev went
      # 35 versions stale unnoticed. Removing the flag from pubspec re-enables.
      - id: gate
        name: Publish gate
        run: |
          if grep -Eq '^publish_to:[[:space:]]*none' pubspec.yaml; then
            echo "::error::pubspec.yaml sets publish_to: none — a tagged release cannot reach pub.dev. Remove the flag from pubspec.yaml, or stop tagging v* releases (see #554)."
            exit 1
          fi
          # gh-1452: pub.dev server-rejects the upload when CHANGELOG.md is
          # at/over its 262144-byte content cap (v1.0.538 died mid-upload,
          # after the tag + GitHub release). Fast-fail HERE, before staging
          # and publish, not at the server.
          bash scripts/check_changelog_size.sh CHANGELOG.md
          echo "publishable=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

{"content":"### What changed
- Trimmed `CHANGELOG.md` 263 008 → 16 359 bytes (262 144 = the pub.dev cap that server-rejected v1.0.538 mid-upload): keeps the last 30 versions (1.0.506 → 1.0.540) + `## Unreleased` inline, losslessly archives the other 417 sections to `CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md`. CHANGELOG-only commit, no version bump; v1.0.538 stays GitHub-release-only.
- Added `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` (fails with `::error::` at size ≥ 262 144) wired into both release surfaces: `scripts/auto_release.sh` runs it **after the changelog rewrite, before the bump commit/push** (pre-tag), and the ci.yml `publish` job gate runs it **before staging/`dart pub publish`** (pre-upload).

### Key decisions
- Archive (not delete): the tail stays in-repo and reversible; GitHub releases already carry the per-version history.
- Guard measured post-entry in `auto_release.sh`, so the abort happens before tag_release/publish can fire — the approach of the cap now surfaces pre-tag, not mid-upload (the v1.0.538 failure point).
- Extracted script + repo-standard shell-harness tests; the release sandbox ships the real guard (same pattern as `check_lockfiles.sh`).

### How to verify
```bash
bash scripts/check_changelog_size.sh   # CHANGELOG.md: 16359 bytes < 262144-byte cap — ok
dart test test/changelog_cap_guard_test.dart test/release_hygiene_test.dart
```
- New behavioral coverage: over-cap changelog aborts `auto_release.sh` with origin/main unchanged; guard boundary tests (262143 pass / 262144+1 fail, missing file, custom cap); wiring assertions for both call sites.

Hmm — the tail shows:
```
✅ ... (several passes)
malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk detected
Aborted (core dumped)
```
and the job's exit code is 0 — but that's the exit code of `tail -6` (the pipe's last command), which masks dart's real exit. The "malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk detected / Aborted (core dumped)" is a glibc heap-corruption abort — the suite process crashed at the very end (after those last tests passed). This looks like a native/FFI teardown crash (the repo has sqlite3/FFI and PTY suites) — notoriously a teardown-order crash in some suite, not necessarily a test failure.

I can't tell from `tail -6` whether all tests passed before the abort. I need the full picture. Unfortunately my command piped through `tail -6`, discarding everything else. I must re-run to get a reliable verdict — but this time with `--file-reporter` or capture the whole output, and avoid the pipe-masking.

Also note: this crash could be pre-existing/flaky (a known FFI teardown issue in the sandbox) — CI runs the suite in shards. Let me re-run the full suite capturing full output to a file, then inspect the summary line and any failures. Use `--exclude-tags llm` again (same convention), plus `--reporter compact`? The default reporter writes progress to stderr? dart test writes results to stdout. Save both.

Better: `dart test --exclude-tags llm --file-reporter json:...`? The JSON reporter output would be huge but greppable. Simpler: capture full text output to a file and read the tail + grep for "[E]" and the final counts. No pipe masking: run dart directly with output redirect (no `| tail`).

The abort happened at the very END (the ✅ lines before it are from the last file). If all tests passed and then the process aborted during teardown, the exit code of dart would be non-zero (aborted → 134). With `set -o pipefail` absent and `tail` last, the job reported 0.

Re-run: `dart test --exclude-tags llm > /tmp/full1.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"` in background, then inspect. That's another ~25 min. Fine — do it in background and poll between steps.

Actually wait — should I shard it to reduce risk of another OOM/abort? Keep it simple: same invocation as CI's aggregate but unsharded. The abort might have been caused by my changelog test writing a 262KB temp file? No — heap corruption in glibc is native (FFI suites). And notably my `changelog_cap_guard_test.dart` ran fine standalone (9 passes).

Also consider: was the abort caused by running MY suite in parallel earlier? The malloc_consolidate crash — there are known issues with package:sqlite3 FFI at teardown. It happened at the END of the run, after the last test file completed with ✅. Plausibly a shutdown-time native destructor race — flaky, environmental.

Let me re-run with full capture. If it recurs, identify which suite crashes and whether it's pre-existing on the base commit (stash my changes? they're committed... I can run on origin/main via a worktree — but shallow clone makes worktrees off origin/main fine: `git worktree add`).
